node.statement: After first fixing one global witness package W_RF supplied by lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation, for every input (H,Phi,eta) to which that formation result applies, fix one def-routef-raw-factor-setting datum S over that same W_RF supplied by the same result, writing the fields of (W_RF,S) as the unqualified symbols below: Delta-prime CP closeness: with C_Delta' := C_T+4*C_theta and rho_Delta' := min{rho_T, rho_prod}, for 0 <= eta <= rho_Delta', the repaired norm-one diagonal produces a CP map Delta' with ||Delta' - tilde-Delta||_cb <= C_Delta'*eta.
